'''Trần Thanh Vân,''' also known as '''Jean Trần Thanh Vân''' (born 4 July 1936, [[Đồng Hới]], [[Quảng Bình Province]]), is a Vietnamese-French physicist.

== Biography ==
Vân attended secondary school in [[Huế]]. In 1953, he left [[Vietnam]] for [[France]]. He studied mathematics and physics at [[University of Paris]] and earned his undergraduate degrees in 1957.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=8 September 2014|title=Jean Trân Thanh Vân|url=https://www.aip.org/aip/awards/tate-medal/jean-tr%C3%A2n-thanh-v%C3%A2n|access-date=6 December 2021|website=aip.org|language=en}}</ref> For his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD work]], Vân, still at the University of Paris, turned his studies toward [[particle physics]], focusing on the [[neutron]] as the natural partner of the [[proton]] in the structure of matter. He defended his thesis and obtained his doctoral degree in 1963.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Tran Thanh Van|first=Jean|year=1964|title=Contribution à l'étude des corrections relativistes à la fonction d'onde du deutéron et à la diffusion élastique électron-deutéron|url=http://www.annphys.org/10.1051/anphys/196413090139|journal=Annales de Physique|volume=13|issue=9|pages=139–178|doi=10.1051/anphys/196413090139|bibcode=1964AnPh...13..139T |issn=0003-4169|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Contribution à l'étude des corrections relativistes à la fonction d'onde du deutéron et à la diffusion élastique électron-deutéron / par Jean Trân Thanh Vân,...|url=https://www.sudoc.fr/230830722|access-date=6 December 2021|publisher=Sudoc|date=1963 |last1=Trâǹ |first1=Jean Thanh Vân |last2=Gourdin |first2=Michel |last3=Jancovici |first3=Bernard }}</ref>

After his PhD, Vân joined the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] (CNRS), where he spent his whole career. In 1991, he was given the title ''Directeur de Recherches'', the most senior research position in France. As of 2001 he is emeritus ''Directeur de Recherches.''<ref>{{Cite web|date=28 June 2016|title=Jean Tran Thanh Van : "Sans science fondamentale, le monde ne peut pas avancer"|url=https://www.sciencesetavenir.fr/decouvrir/agenda/jean-tran-thanh-van-sans-science-fondamentale-le-monde-ne-peut-pas-avancer_23494|access-date=6 December 2021|website=Sciences et Avenir|language=fr}}</ref>

Vân's scientific work has focused on nucleon interactions at medium energy and the deuteron's relativistic wave function, the 2-body interactions at high energy, [[Regge poles]] and absorption models and the dual parton model. He has co-authored more than 300 scientific articles.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Jean Trân Thanh Vân's author profile in INSPIRE|url=https://inspirehep.net/authors/985014|access-date=6 December 2021|website=inspirehep.net}}</ref>

Vân is a promoter of the [[International Year of Basic Sciences for Sustainable Development]], which was proclaimed by the [[United Nations General Assembly]] in December 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Jean Trân Thanh Vân|url=https://www.iybssd2022.org/en/dt_team/jean-tran-thanh-van/|access-date=3 December 2021|website=International Year of Basic Sciences for Development|language=en-GB}}</ref>

== Rencontres ==
Trần Thanh Vân has become internationally renowned as the organizer of scientific meetings, in particular for the series Rencontres de Moriond, Rencontres de Blois and Rencontres du Vietnam.<ref name=":1" />

=== Rencontres de Moriond ===
The first meeting took place at Moriond in the French Alps in 1966.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last=Del Rosso|first=Antonella|date=2 April 2012|title=The inventor of the "Rencontres"|url=https://cds.cern.ch/journal/CERNBulletin/2012/14/News%20Articles/1434426?ln=en|access-date=6 December 2021|website=CERN Bulletin|publisher=CERN}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Jepsen|first=Kathryn|date=1 May 2012|title=One degree of separation: the Vietnam connection|url=https://www.symmetrymagazine.org/article/may-2012/one-degree-of-separation-the-vietnam-connection|access-date=3 December 2021|website=Symmetry Magazine|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=27 February 2013|title=ATLAS in the Italian Alps for the Rencontres de Moriond 2013|url=https://atlas.cern/updates/news/atlas-italian-alps-rencontres-de-moriond-2013|access-date=3 December 2021|website=ATLAS Collaboration|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=19 March 2015|title=50 years of particle physics at Moriond|url=http://home.cern/fr/node/4842|access-date=3 December 2021|website=CERN|language=en}}</ref>
=== Rencontres de Blois ===
Since 1989 the «[http://blois.in2p3.fr Rencontres de Blois]» have been organised in the city of [[Blois]], in France. While the Blois meetings have dealt with several topics, one of their great achievements has been to recognize (like Moriond) the cross-disciplinary field of [[astroparticle physics]]. The meetings have covered topics ranging from particle physics to chaos theory, life and planetary science.<ref>{{Cite web|date=23 April 2014|title=Le Docteur-professeur Trân Thanh Vân et sa ''Rencontre de Blois''|url=https://fr.nhandan.vn/societe/pays_natal/item/64871-le-docteur-professeur-tran-thanh-van-et-sa-rencontre-de-blois.html|access-date=3 December 2021|website=Nhândân en ligne|language=fr}}</ref>

=== Rencontres du Vietnam ===
The series «[https://rencontresduvietnam.org Rencontres du Vietnam]»started in 1993 when Vietnam first re-opened to foreign scientists. The meetings are based on the same principle as for Moriond and Blois.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Pepe Altarelli|first=Monica|year=1994|title=Physics in Vietnam|url=https://cds.cern.ch/record/1732256|journal=CERN Courier|volume=34|issue=2|pages=17–18}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=5 May 2015|title=Internationally famous Vietnamese scientists|url=https://hanoitimes.vn/internationally-famous-vietnamese-scientists-43490.html|access-date=3 December 2021|website=Hanoi Times|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=26 May 2018|title=Chuyện kể năm 2018 của Giáo sư Trần Thanh Vân|url=https://www.thesaigontimes.vn/272963/chuyen-ke-nam-2018-cua-giao-su-tran-thanh-van.html|url-status=live|archive-date=28 September 2020|access-date=6 December 2021|website=Saigon Times Weekly|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200928184024/https://www.thesaigontimes.vn/272963/chuyen-ke-nam-2018-cua-giao-su-tran-thanh-van.html |language=Vietnamese}}</ref>

== Private life ==
He is married to Lê Kim Ngoc since 1961.<ref>{{Cite web|title=All for the home country|url=https://baobinhduong.vn/en/all-for-the-home-country-a35720.html|access-date=2021-12-06|website=baobinhduong.vn|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|date=27 May 2013|title=Kim et Jean Tran, mariés avec la science|language=fr|work=Le Monde.fr|url=https://www.lemonde.fr/sciences/article/2013/05/27/kim-et-jean-tran-maries-avec-la-science_3418198_1650684.html|access-date=3 December 2021}}</ref> The couple has two adult children. In 1970 Vân and Ngoc established the association «Aide à l’Enfance du Vietnam», to set up the [[SOS Children's Villages|SOS Children's Village]] in Vietnam.<ref>{{Cite web|last=VnExpress|title=A passion for science, a deep love for Vietnam - VnExpress International|url=https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/a-passion-for-science-a-deep-love-for-vietnam-3759111.html|access-date=6 December 2021|website=VnExpress International|language=en}}</ref>
